conjecture: The AAGM one-hole container derivative is the differential combinator of a Cartesian differential category SPoly of polynomial functors; equivalently it is the first-order Cartesian tangent structure realised by dual-number substitution T(p)=p(y+εv) mod ε².

tree.approach: Define SPoly (objects ℕ, morphisms iso-classes of polynomial functors, substitution); exhibit ∂ as differential combinator; prove CDC axioms by reflection along the faithful counting functor N into the classical CDC Poly_ℕ. Then CDC ⟹ Cartesian tangent category, realised by dual numbers.

children.approach: N: SPoly→Poly_ℕ preserves all CDC data (Lemma 3) and is faithful on iso-classes (Lemma 4); faithful functors reflect equations of parallel maps (Lemma 5), so the CDC axioms descend from Poly_ℕ to SPoly.
Counting identities: ∘↦∘, +↦+, ×↦×, proj/tuple preserved, and N(∂_iF)=∂N(F)/∂m_i. Verified symbolically + 2000 random multivariable containers.
N(F)=Σ_s ∏ m_i^{|P^i_s|}; its monomials recover the multiset of exponent-vectors = the container iso-class. Injective within fixed arity (confirmed 4000 trials each n=1,2,3).
Polynomials over the rig ℕ with Jacobian form a CDC (BCS 2009, motivating example; axioms use only +,×,d/dx, no subtraction). Nontrivial axioms CD.5/6/7 also symbolic-checked here with abstract f.
CD.5 combinatorial content: ∂(G◁F)≅(∂G◁F)×∂F, explicit bijection (indexed-Leibniz hole split). Re-read in full this session; complete bijective proof, brute-forced on 23 containers.

Prop 6: a map 1→1 is CDC-linear iff D[f]=f∘π₂ iff f=S·y. Corrects the memo's 'linear OBJECTS=S·y' (vacuous here, SPoly is a full CDC) to 'linear MAPS=S·y'. Non-vacuity certificate: y linear, y² not. Map-level discriminator machine-verified in lean-tangent-bridge-finite (y,5y linear; y²,y³,const,affine not; zero axioms).

CD.6: setting b'=0 kills the two-hole (Case B) term, Case T ≅ D[F]. CD.7 (Clairaut): swap involution on ordered distinct hole-pairs (s,h1,h2)↦(s,h2,h1). Container isos; symbolic + 500-trial corroboration.

Stage-1 finite check: ε-coeff of p(y+εv)=v·∂p for p∈{1,y,y²,y³,y⁵,sums,scaled}. Corroborates (subsumed by N-preserves-cdc-data). Decisive first move, non-load-bearing. Now machine-certified: Horner-expanded dual-number T over ℕ[y] gives epsCoeff(T(yⁿ))=∂(yⁿ) for n≤5, sorry-free, zero axioms.
